scope: Synthetic finite-strain generalized-Maxwell (Prony, 1-8 branches) material point on the multiplicative split F=FeFv: quadratic Hencky energy, deviatoric-only viscous flow, exponential-map return in principal log space; general-F stepping API and a traction-free uniaxial driver. Not calibrated, not compared with experiments, no plasticity/damage/structural integration.

syntheticParameters.note: Same synthetic fixture as work order 72; not a measured material.

protocol: E11 ramp 0->0.03 in 1 s, hold 2 s, unload to 0 in 1 s, hold 2 s, reload to 0.03 in 1 s; 20 steps per segment; lateral sigma22=sigma33=0 by safeguarded secant

comparisonWith72.smallStrainLimit: E11 amplitude 1e-5, same loop: max |S11 difference| / peak = 4.47e-3 at 20 steps/segment, 4.79e-4 at 200 steps/segment (first-order convergence to the linear-E exact-interval driver)
comparisonWith72.finiteStrain: E11 amplitude 0.03: S11 differs by ~8.5% of peak and dissipation 621 vs 656 J/m3 at 200 steps/segment; this is a genuine difference of strain measure (Hencky vs Green-Lagrange) and integrator, not an error estimate of either model

verification: small-strain limit converges to the work-order-72 driver (S11 rel. error < 1e-3, dissipation < 3e-3) and the error falls with refinement
objectivity: 40 steps of a non-coaxial path with a time-varying superposed rotation Q(t): sigma(QF)=Q sigma(F) Q^T to 1e-5 Pa, identical dissipation and stored energy
pure rigid rotation from the virgin state gives zero stress and zero dissipation
uniaxial loop: sigma22~0 every step, dissipation nondecreasing, relaxation during hold, compressive viscous memory at E11=0 recovering toward zero, no plastic residual
glassy (dt/tau=5e-6) and fully relaxed limits match an independent closed-form Hencky uniaxial oracle
faster loading raises peak P11; time refinement 8/16/32 vs 512 converges

refusals: calibrated/synthetic flags, extra fields, 0 or 9 branches, sum mu_k > mu_inf, K/mu out of range, stretch > 1.05 (uniaxial and general F), >4096 steps, zero duration/dt, empty segments, foreign state; input unchanged; outputs frozen
unverified: no experimental data: no calibration, no comparison with measured curves
stretch envelope stays 0.95-1.05; no strong-ellipticity or polyconvexity argument for wider range (quadratic Hencky is not polyconvex)
exponential return is exact only for a fixed trial; within-step path is first order; dissipation is algorithmic (midpoint), no exact energy-balance identity as in 72
full CI not run in this session
remainingParentAcceptance: Experimental calibration, finite plasticity/viscoplasticity, damage, element/Newton tangent and structural path (reactions, deformed area), dumbbell necking and mesh regularization, RESULTCURVE1 history integration.
